exercises.name: Squat (Bodyweight)
exercises.pose_description_uk: Нижня фаза присідання: стегна паралельні підлозі, п’яти на опорі, спина рівна.

source_english.description: Squat (Bodyweight) lowers the hips by bending the hips and knees and returns to standing by driving through the feet.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outward.
Lower your body down by bending your knees and pushing your hips back as if you were sitting on a chair.
Keep your chest up and your back straight throughout the movement.
Lower yourself until your thighs are parallel to the ground or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
form_cues: Keep the knees tracking the toes.
Brace the trunk through the depth.
common_mistakes: Bouncing or cutting the depth short.
source_english.safety_note: Use a rack or machine stops and choose a depth you can control with both feet planted.

exercises.source_interpretation_note: The generic safety_note mentions a rack or machine stops, but this ID is equipment=none and its movement instructions explicitly define a bodyweight squat; no rack or machine is included.

exercises.name: Push Up
exercises.pose_description_uk: Нижня фаза віджимання: груди над килимком, опора на долоні й носки, корпус прямий.

source_english.description: From a high plank, lower the chest toward the floor and press back up while keeping the body straight.
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your feet together.
Engage your core and lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping your body in a straight line.
Pause for a moment when your chest is just above the ground, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
form_cues: Keep wrists stacked over the elbows.
Brace the trunk and keep the shoulder blades controlled.
Use a smooth lower and press.
source_english.safety_note: Use a stable setup and stop before the shoulders or wrists lose controlled alignment.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.pose_description_uk: Планка на передпліччях: лікті під плечима, ноги прямі, таз на лінії корпусу.

source_english.description: A plank holds the body in a straight line while the trunk resists sagging, rotation, and unwanted hip movement.
instructions: Set the hands or forearms under the shoulders and extend the legs behind you.
Brace the abdomen and squeeze the glutes to form a straight line from head to heels.
Breathe steadily while holding the position without shifting the hips.
Lower the knees to the floor to end the hold with control.
source_english.safety_note: Stop the hold when you can no longer keep the spine and hips aligned.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.pose_description_uk: Бічна планка: опора на одне передпліччя та складені стопи, таз піднятий.

source_english.description: Support the body on one forearm and stacked feet, lift the hips into a straight line, then lower and switch sides.
instructions: Start by lying on your side with your legs extended and stacked on top of each other.
Place your forearm on the ground directly below your shoulder, with your elbow bent at a 90-degree angle.
Engage your core and lift your hips off the ground, creating a straight line from your head to your feet.
Hold this position for the desired amount of time.
Lower your hips back down to the ground and repeat on the other side.
common_mistakes: Using momentum instead of the target joint path.
source_english.safety_note: Use a secure setup and stop if alignment or control is lost.

source_english.description: Hold dumbbells at the sides, elevate both shoulders vertically, then lower them without rolling.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing your body.
Keep your arms straight and let the dumbbells hang by your sides.
Raise your shoulders as high as possible, as if you are trying to touch your ears with your shoulders.
Hold the contraction for a second, then slowly lower your shoulders back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
common_mistakes: Using momentum instead of the target joint path.
source_english.safety_note: Use a secure setup and stop if alignment or control is lost.

exercises.pose_description_uk: Лежачи на килимку, гантелі над грудьми; коліна зігнуті, лопатки мають опору.

source_english.description: Floor Press (Dumbbell) is a supported chest press using one dumbbell in each hand.
instructions: Lie on the floor with knees bent. Grip one dumbbell in each hand and hold it over the chest.
Lower the resistance toward the chest with elbows controlled.
Pause without bouncing or losing shoulder position.
Press back to straight arms, then rerack or set the weights down safely.
source_english.safety_note: Use a spotter or safeties for the loaded press and stop before shoulder control is lost.
